example_1_en: Capacitive reactance is the opposition of a capacitor to alternating current.
example_1_zh: 容抗是電容器對交流電所呈現的阻礙。
example_2_en: Capacitive reactance is dependent on frequency and capacitance.
example_2_zh: 容抗取決於頻率與電容量。

example_1_en: Inductive reactance is the opposition of an inductor to alternating current.
example_1_zh: 感抗是電感器對交流電所呈現的阻礙。
example_2_en: Inductive reactance is greater when frequency or inductance increases.
example_2_zh: 當頻率或電感增加時，感抗會變大。

example_1_en: Conductance is the reciprocal of electrical resistance.
example_2_zh: 電導以西門子為單位表示。

example_1_en: The phase angle changes as the bond impedance changes with frequency.
example_1_zh: 接合阻抗隨頻率變化時，相位角也會改變。
example_2_en: The engineer records the phase angle with the impedance measurement.
example_2_zh: 工程師會將相位角與阻抗量測結果一起記錄。

example_1_en: Impedance is a complex quantity with magnitude and phase.
example_1_zh: 阻抗是具有大小與相位的複數量。
example_2_en: The engineer records the complex quantity in the test report.
example_2_zh: 工程師會在測試報告中記錄複數量。

example_1_en: The imaginary part of impedance changes with frequency.
example_1_zh: 阻抗的虛部會隨頻率改變。
example_2_en: The engineer plots the imaginary part beside the real part.
example_2_zh: 工程師會將虛部與實部一起繪圖。

example_1_en: Surface resistance is measured along the surface of a material.
example_1_zh: 表面電阻是沿材料表面量測的電阻。
example_2_en: Surface resistance is important when evaluating static-charge dissipation.
example_2_zh: 評估靜電荷消散時，表面電阻很重要。

example_1_en: Bulk resistivity is an intrinsic electrical property of a material.
example_1_zh: 體積電阻率是材料本身的電氣特性。
example_2_en: Bulk resistivity is used to compare conductive and insulating materials.
example_2_zh: 體積電阻率用於比較導電與絕緣材料。

example_1_en: Electrostatic charge is an imbalance of electric charge on an item.
example_1_zh: 靜電荷是物件上電荷不平衡的狀態。
example_2_en: Electrostatic charge is dissipated through a suitable bonding path.
example_2_zh: 靜電荷會經由適當的接合路徑消散。

example_1_en: The copper layer acts as a local reference plane.
example_1_zh: 銅層可作為局部參考平面。
example_2_en: All critical shields should return to the reference plane.
example_2_zh: 所有關鍵屏蔽都應回到參考平面。

example_1_en: The circuit model defines a zero reference potential.
example_1_zh: 電路模型會定義零參考電位。
example_2_en: The engineer measures voltage relative to the zero reference potential.
example_2_zh: 工程師會相對於零參考電位量測電壓。

example_1_en: The primary structure carries the main vehicle loads.
example_1_zh: 主結構承受載具的主要載荷。
example_2_en: The bonding path connects the equipment to the primary structure.
example_2_zh: 接合路徑會將設備連接至主結構。

example_1_en: The secondary structure supports the equipment panel.
example_2_en: The engineer checks the bond to the secondary structure.
example_2_zh: 工程師會檢查與次結構的接合。

example_1_en: The tertiary structure supports local hardware.
example_1_zh: 第三級結構支撐局部硬體。
example_2_en: The drawing identifies the bond to the tertiary structure.
example_2_zh: 圖面會標示與第三級結構的接合。

example_1_en: The two metal surfaces need to fay closely before the fasteners are tightened.
example_1_zh: 在緊固件鎖緊前，兩個金屬表面須緊密貼合。
example_2_en: The installer prepares the mating surfaces to fay without a visible gap.
example_2_zh: 安裝人員會準備配合面，使其接合時沒有可見間隙。
